name: Yamae (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Yamae village emblem in navy: a stylised device of three pointed leaves, like a crown.
history: Municipal flag of Yamae, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 May 1979.

features.role: Yamae village emblem — a stylised device of three pointed leaves, like a crown
